label: Glycoconjugate synthesis and lysosomal glycan catabolism
reason: N-glycosylation/CDG, nucleotide-sugar and sialic acid synthesis, GPI anchors and lysosomal glycosphingolipid/oligosaccharide breakdown, linked by shared glycan structures and sugar donors.

label: IL-1 family cytokines and IL-17/Th17 axis
reason: IL-1/IL-18/IL-36/IL-38 processing and signalling plus IL-17/Th17, linked by the established IL-1-family drive of Th17/IL-17 inflammation.

label: Oxidative and nitrosative stress responses
reason: ROS/RNS detoxification, peroxide responses, HMOX1/BACH1, redox homeostasis and ferroptosis all form one redox-stress theme.

label: Protein quality control and ubiquitin-proteasome degradation
reason: Misfolded protein response, ERAD, E3 ligases, DUBs, N-end rule and reticulophagy share one proteostasis theme.

label: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signalling
reason: Destruction complex, CTNNB1/APC/AXIN mutants, DVL, TCF/LEF and pathway regulators are all canonical Wnt.

label: Peroxisomal fatty acid and ether lipid metabolism
reason: VLCFA beta-oxidation, phytanate alpha-oxidation, plasmalogen/ether synthesis, ABCD1 and TYSND1 are peroxisomal lipid metabolism.

label: Dystroglycan glycosylation and muscle-basement membrane
reason: DAG1 O-mannosyl glycosylation/dystroglycanopathies, laminin/basement membrane, DGC and muscle/NMJ development linked by the dystroglycan-laminin axis.

label: Death receptor apoptosis and necroptosis
reason: TRAIL/FasL, caspase-8, c-FLIP, BID and RIPK1/TRIF necroptosis are one extrinsic cell death theme.

label: Vascular wall smooth muscle and endothelial remodelling
reason: VSMC phenotypic switching/proliferation/migration, SRF targets and endothelial shear-stress responses form one vascular wall biology theme.

label: Inorganic anion transport and acid-base
reason: Phosphate, bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide and oxalate SLC transporters, their diseases and carbonic anhydrase/pH regulation share one theme.

label: Axon guidance and neurite extension
reason: Ephrin, semaphorin, netrin, SLIT/ROBO, L1/DSCAM signalling and axon sprouting/regeneration are all axon guidance.

label: Viral life cycle and host interaction
reason: Entry, replication, protein maturation, translation and assembly of SARS-CoV, RSV, dengue, influenza and HIV plus host restriction form one virology theme.

label: Fucosylated glycans and selectin ligands
reason: GDP-fucose and ABO/Lewis antigen synthesis plus leukocyte rolling/HSC homing and tyrosine sulfation, linked by fucosylated sLeX and sulfated PSGL-1 selectin ligands.

label: miRNA-mediated gene silencing
reason: miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly, translational repression, deadenylation and P-bodies form one theme.

label: DNA repair synthesis and translesion synthesis
reason: NER, BER, TLS and replication/telomere C-strand polymerase switching linked by shared PCNA-dependent DNA polymerase synthesis machinery.

label: TLR3/4/7/8/9 TRIF and IRAK signalling
reason: Endosomal TLR trafficking, TRIF/TICAM1, IRAK/TRAF6/TAK1, IRF3/7 activation and HSE deficiencies are one TLR signalling theme.

label: Centrosome, microtubule organisation and spindle orientation
reason: Centriole duplication, MTOC nucleation/anchoring, astral microtubules and spindle positioning form one theme.

label: Nuclear RNA processing, splicing and export
reason: Splicing, snRNP assembly, 3'-end processing, histone mRNA processing, nuclear RNA decay and mRNA export are one nuclear RNA theme.

label: RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling and mutants
reason: RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK activation, oncogenic mutants, GAPs, SOS and negative feedback are all one pathway.

label: Cytokine JAK-STAT interleukin signalling
reason: IL-2/7/15/21, IL-6/LIF/CNTF, IL-10/12/23/27 family signalling and STAT regulation are one cytokine-receptor theme.

label: Lung and trachea development
reason: Lung branching, pneumocyte differentiation, lung mesenchyme and trachea formation dominate; diaphragm and ductus are minor odd members.

label: Telomere maintenance and protection
reason: Telomere capping, ALT recombination, ATRX/DAXX, C-strand synthesis and telomerase regulation form one theme.

label: Meiotic recombination and chromosome segregation
reason: Meiotic DSB formation, synapsis, chiasma, cohesion, spindle and oocyte meiotic divisions are all meiosis.

label: ER stress, integrated stress response, NRF2, FOXO
reason: UPR/ISR kinases, NFE2L2 and FOXO/AKT transcription linked as adaptive stress-responsive transcription (PERK-NRF2, ATF4, AKT-FOXO survival-death decisions).

label: Presynaptic modulation of neurotransmitter release
reason: GPCR/Gbeta-gamma inhibition of Ca channels, GIRK, kainate presynaptic function and GABA/glutamate release regulation form one theme.

label: B cell, germinal centre and plasma cells
reason: B cell BTMs and surface signatures, GC/Tfh differentiation, plasma cells and B cell proliferation regulation share one theme.

label: MITF-M melanocyte programme and UV response
reason: MITF-M target gene regulation and melanocyte differentiation plus UV-A/B responses, linked by UV-induced melanogenesis via MITF.

label: Haematopoietic lineage differentiation (myeloid, erythroid, megakaryocyte)
reason: Erythroid, granulocytic, megakaryocytic and HSC regulation with RUNX1 transcription form one haematopoiesis theme; a few odd members (RHOBTB1, keratinocyte RUNX1).

label: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and wound re-epithelialisation
reason: Keratinocyte growth/differentiation/apoptosis and epidermal wound spreading dominate; generic adhesion/junction modules are minor.

label: Chemokine-driven leukocyte migration and lymphoid homing
reason: Chemokines/receptors, leukocyte and DC chemotaxis, lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development form one immune trafficking theme; a few misfits.

label: FGFR signalling
reason: FGFR1-4 ligand binding, FRS/SHC cascades, Klotho, Spry and FGFRL1 regulation are all FGF receptor signalling.

label: T cell adhesion and immunological synapse
reason: Leukocyte integrin adhesion, T cell polarity, immunological synapse, rafts and CORO1A-DEF6 networks share one theme.

label: Non-canonical Wnt/PCP and convergent extension
reason: PCP signalling, Wnt5a/ROR2, Wnt-Ca2+, Wnt secretion and convergent extension in gastrulation/organogenesis are one theme.

label: Hedgehog and PCP in neural tube/axis patterning
reason: Hedgehog/GLI signalling and Wnt-PCP convergent extension linked through neural plate, floor plate and axial mesoderm morphogenesis (and primary cilia).

label: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA and 2-oxoacid metabolism
reason: Fatty acid beta-oxidation, BCAA/lysine catabolism disorders, PDH/OGDH/TCA, ketone bodies and CoA/lipoate/biotin cofactors, linked by shared acyl-CoA intermediates and lipoylated dehydrogenases.

label: Collagen, elastic fibre and basement membrane ECM
reason: Collagen biosynthesis, trimerisation, crosslinking, anchoring fibrils, elastic fibres and laminin/basement membrane are one ECM theme.

label: NMDA/AMPA receptor signalling, LTP and CREB
reason: Glutamate receptor activation, Ca2+-CaMK-CREB, Ras/RAC1 downstream of NMDARs and LTP/memory form one theme.

label: Myelination and axon regeneration/glial response
reason: CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance plus axon regeneration/RhoA growth inhibition and gliosis, linked by glia-axon interactions and myelin-associated growth inhibitors.

label: Hedgehog/GLI signalling
reason: SMO, GLI processing/degradation and Hh transcription form the core, but NOTCH4, estrogen receptor, retinoic acid, SLIT/ROBO and DVL members (~40%) do not belong.

label: Nucleoside transport and adenine nucleotide energy homeostasis
reason: ENT nucleoside/drug transport, nucleotide interconversion, creatine-phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP carrier (with ANT-linked MOMP) linked by adenine nucleotide handling.
